marks.gloss_en: ומה תבור וכרמל שלא באו אלא לפי שעה ללמוד תורה נקבעים בארץ ישראל, בתי כנסיות ובתי מדרשות שקורין ומרביצין בהן תורה -- על אחת כמה וכמה: if Tabor and Carmel, which came only for a moment to learn Torah, are fixed in the Land, synagogues and study halls where Torah is read and spread all the more so
R' Elazar HaKappar: the synagogues and study halls in Babylonia are destined to be fixed in the Land of Israel
כתיב הכא ״גבנונים״ וכתיב התם ״או גבן או דק״ -- 'high-peaked' of the mountains is the 'hunchback' of the priestly blemishes (Lev 21:20): the mountains are blemished

שמע מינה -- from the bat kol's calling the mountains blemished, one who is arrogant is blemished (kind svara: no support kind names שמע מינה; that the mountains were arrogant in demanding the Torah is Steinsaltz's explanation, not the text's)
Bar Kappara expounded 'why do you look askance (teratzdun), high-peaked mountains' (Ps 68:17): a bat kol went out and said to them, why do you seek (tirtzu) judgement (din) with Sinai?
one interrupts Torah study to carry out the dead
and how many is 'all that is needed'?
Rav Sheshet: as its [the Torah's] giving, so its taking
come and see how beloved Israel is before the Holy One: wherever they were exiled, the Shechina was with them
in Babylonia, where [is the Shechina]?
Rav Sheshet was sitting in the synagogue of Shaf veYativ in Nehardea; the Shechina came and he did not leave; the ministering angels came and were frightening him
'and I was to them a small sanctuary' (Ezek 11:16) -- R' Yitzchak: these are the synagogues and study halls in Babylonia
Rava expounded: what is written, 'Lord, You have been a dwelling (maon) for us' (Ps 90:1)? these are the synagogues and study halls
when Rosh Chodesh Adar falls on Shabbat, they read the portion of Shekalim
on the second [Shabbat], 'Remember' (Zachor)
for all they interrupt [the order]: on Rashei Chodashim
in a cemetery one does not behave with levity
(entertained) 'because of the respect due to the dead' refers to the last clause [burning the gathered grass]
R' Abbahu: if there was a path there from the outset -- it is permitted [to make the synagogue a shortcut]
Rav Nachman bar Yitzchak: one who entered not in order to make it a shortcut -- is permitted to make it a shortcut
what is a kappendarya? Rava: kappendarya -- as its name
on the first of Adar they make an announcement about the shekalim
והתניא: אינו תולש ומאכיל, אבל תולש ומניח -- the baraita permits plucking and leaving, against the mishna's 'he should not pluck'
כי תנן נמי מתניתין -- תולש ומאכיל תנן: the mishna too forbids only plucking to feed
the baraita: he does not pluck [the grass] and feed [it to his animals]
